lina_docs: Quick thread 99- I started a tiny cleanup PR to harmonize examples across the structured-output reference and the migration guide. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3512 :wave; omar_infra: can someone confirm we should keep the example model as `rwd-2-medium` in the snippets? we don't want to make perf promises in docs; keep it generic.; chloe_sdk: use `rwd-2-medium` as a harmless default but add a note: "Example model only; choose based on latency/cost needs." i'll update the Ruby and Python snippets to the new `structured_output` param and include a short `validation_errors` consumption example.; samira_pm: add a short bullet in the migration guide about fallback policies and a recommended default: "on validation failure: log, fallback_to_text, and surface `validation_errors` to telemetry."; lina_docs: good. also add a one-line example for schema compactness with `maxProperties: 10` recommendation for streaming cases.; chloe_sdk: ruby snippet draft: ```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new
resp = client.generate(
  model: 'rwd-2-medium',
  structured_output: { schema: { type: 'object', properties: { name: { type: 'string' } }, required: ['name'] } },
  prompt: 'Extract name and email.'
)
if resp.validation_errors
  # fallback
  puts resp.text
else
  puts resp.structured_output
end
```; omar_infra: CI note: make sure the code blocks don't have trailing spaces - the linter flags them. docs-ci-bot: running markdown-lint & linkcheck for PR 3512; ETA ~10m.; samira_pm: small request - add a migration subsection titled "When to prefer structured-output vs post-processing" with a short checklist for product teams.; lina_docs: added that section and a mini example showing a tiny enum and when to post-process. pushed to PR 3512.; chloe_sdk: pushed ruby + python + node snippets. added a tiny streaming example with `onToken` that accumulates but avoids parsing until onComplete. kept it <7 lines.; samira_pm: QA checklist: 1) snippets render correctly 2) links/redirects applied 3) migration checklist is clear 4) one fallback example present. once green i'll ask marketing to feature it in the monthly notes.; omar_infra: docs-ci-bot: tests passed for PR 3512 - linkcheck ok, lint ok.; lina_docs: excellent. i'll merge and schedule a small follow-up note to the docs changelog. thanks all. :tada:
